facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map.
Dr. Uriah can now read languages, letting him read the label under one location on the treasure map per day.
Grimny's ghost says his brother Bral, the dwarf the party won the map from in a gambling bet, probably hid the dwarves' mine hoard at the cave labeled "Dragon's lair" on the map.
The dragon the party is hunting is tied to the Dragon's Lair, where the treasure is probably hidden, and stands in the way of retrieving it.
facts.uncertain_reason: Dunk suspects there is no dragon and that Bral only pretends there is one (beat_78).

facts.text: What is the one still-unidentified location marked on the treasure map? Sir Phidipaldi guesses it is King Hogboon's.
